user.title: Home Maintenance
user.description: Track recurring tasks. Once the integration is added, add your tasks with **Add task**.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Maintenance is already set up.

data_description.notify_targets: Default notification targets (e.g. your phones). A task can override this.
data_description.notify_days_before: 0 disables the reminder. A notification is always sent on the due date.
data_description.notify_runtime_threshold: Warns once when a task with a runtime limit has this much left. 0 disables it. A task can override this.

data_description.interval_value: How often the task repeats, in the unit below. Leave blank if the task only has a runtime limit.
data_description.tag_id: Scanning this tag marks the task as done.

runtime.name: Runtime limit
runtime.description: Makes the task due after a number of hours of use, counted while an entity is on (in any state but off). With an interval too, the task is due at whichever comes first.

data_description.runtime_entity: For example your air conditioner. Leave blank for no runtime limit.
data_description.runtime_hours: Hours of use before the task is due.
data_description.runtime_used: If the item isn't new, the hours it has already been used.

data_description.notify_mode: Default targets are set in the integration's options.
data_description.notify_runtime_threshold: Leave blank for the integration's default. 0 disables it.

data_description.interval_value: How often the task repeats, in the unit below. Leave blank if the task only has a runtime limit.
data_description.tag_id: Scanning this tag marks the task as done.
data_description.enabled: A disabled task is never due and sends no notifications.

runtime.name: Runtime limit
runtime.description: Makes the task due after a number of hours of use, counted while an entity is on (in any state but off). With an interval too, the task is due at whichever comes first.

data_description.runtime_entity: For example your air conditioner. Leave blank for no runtime limit.
data_description.runtime_hours: Hours of use before the task is due.
data_description.runtime_used: Hours counted since the task was last done. Change them to correct the count.

data_description.notify_mode: Default targets are set in the integration's options.
data_description.notify_runtime_threshold: Leave blank for the integration's default. 0 disables it.

error.no_notify_targets: Choose at least one target for custom targets.
error.no_limit: Set an interval, a runtime limit or both.

not_a_task.message: {entity_id} is not a Home Maintenance task.

reset_last_performed.name: Mark task done
reset_last_performed.description: Marks tasks as done, today or on the given date, which sets their next due date.

entity_id.name: Task
entity_id.description: The task's entities: its due sensor or its Mark done button.

send_notifications.name: Send notifications
send_notifications.description: Sends the notifications for due tasks now, the same way the daily check does.
